title: Brand Marketing Executive - 12 month FTC
description:
Think Specialist Recruitment are delighted to be working with a Global organisation based within the Watford area. This company are a market leader within their field, they have an exciting opportunity for a Degree educated candidate with 1-2 years experience, to join their Brand Marketing team. This position will be working closely with the Brand Marketing Managers, playing a key part in planning, delivering and executing brand plans for the business.
This person will need to have 1-2 years experience within Marketing, and due to the fact this company work within the office 4 days, this person will need to be local to the office.

Salary - £28,000 - £32,000 depending on experience
Monday - Friday 9am - 5pm - 4 days in and 1 day from home
Please note - this is an initial 12 month FTC

Some of the duties will include:
- Supporting annual brand plans and coordinating activity across multiple channels
- Helping lead SEO, eCRM and social activity, working with both internal teams and external agencies
- Developing and refining messaging across social, PR, SEO and campaign assets
- Supporting new product launches and working with Product, Trade and Digital teams on go-to-market plans
- Ensuring product and website content is accurate, engaging, optimised and focused on consumer benefits
- Briefing agencies, reviewing creative, coordinating feedback and keeping projects moving
- Ensuring communications consistently reflect brand positioning, tone of voice and visual identity
- Coordinating activity with internal and external partners to deliver a smooth customer experience
- Conducting brand, competitor, marketing and retail audits to identify trends, gaps and opportunities
- Supporting budgets, purchase orders, reporting and day-to-day project management

The suitable candidate:
- Degree Educated candidate
- 1-2 years experience within a marketing focused role
- Previous experience delivering marketing campaigns across multiple channels
- Strong communication skills on all levels both verbal and written
- Has the ability to multi-task and prioritise a busy workload
- Can build strong working relationships both internally and externally
- A good understanding of social media
- Must be local to Watford

Looking for the next step in your career? Think Specialist Recruitment.

Think Specialist Recruitment is an independent support staff recruitment agency based in Hemel Hempstead and working across the Herts, Beds and Bucks area. We specialise in permanent, temporary and contract recruitment with areas of expertise including: administration, customer service/call centre, PA/secretarial, human resources, accountancy and finance, sales admin/sales support, marketing and IT Helpdesk/IT support

title: Communications Officer
description:
Job Title:Communications Officer
Starting Salary: £35,570 - £38,510per annum (pro rata for part time)
Hours: 37
Location: Stevenage, Hybrid - countywide travel
Contract Type:Permanent
Directorate:Resources

About the team

The Corporate Communications team helps Hertfordshire County Council communicate clearly, consistently and effectively with colleagues, residents, partners and stakeholders. We support services across the organisation to engage audiences, manage reputation and tell the stories that showcase the difference we make to communities across Hertfordshire.

You'll join a collaborative and supportive team of communications professionals, working alongside colleagues across media, campaigns, digital and internal communications. Together, we deliver strategic communications that inform, engage and inspire.

About the role

If you're creative, curious and keen to make a real difference, this is a great opportunity to develop your communications career while helping us shape how residents understand and engage with council services. You'll be encouraged to get out into our communities, uncover great stories, create engaging content and help communicate information that matters to people's everyday lives. In return, you'll gain experience across a wide range of communications disciplines, build valuable skills and play an important role in showcasing the positive impact Hertfordshire County Council has on communities across the county.

About you

Essential:
- Experience of creating engaging, accessible content tailored to different audiences and communication channels.
- Experience of identifying and developing stories and case studies
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to write clearly in plain English and adapt messages for different audiences.
- Experience of building and maintaining effective relationships.
- Ability to manage multiple projects, monitor progress and deliver communications activity to agreed deadlines.

Desirable:
- Demonstrable experience of developing and delivering communications activity across a range of channels, including digital, print and media.
- Proven ability to gather, analyse and interpret information, audience insight and performance data to inform communications plans and campaigns.
- Awareness of the media landscape, news agenda and the role of communications in supporting organisational priorities.
- Experience of evaluating communications activity and using insights to improve future performance.
- Experience of working in local government, the public sector or a large, complex organisation.
- Knowledge of media relations and responding to media enquiries.

Qualifications:
- Relevant qualification in communications, public relations, marketing, journalism or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

Other Requirements:
- Ability to travel across Hertfordshire to attend events, gather content and build relationships with stakeholders and communities as required.
- You will be required to be part of an on-call out of hours rota. You will be on-call roughly once a quarter and will be paid. Full training will be provided.

We welcome applications from candidates who currently reside in the UK with established proof of right to work documentation. We are not able to offer sponsorship at this time for this role.

This job role is Level 9. Please locate the job profile here:

To hear more about this opportunity please contact Nick Pearce, Senior Communications Manager

Interview Date: w/c 16/11/2026

How to apply

As part of your application, please upload your most recent CV. Ensure your CV is up to date with your employment history (including any employment gaps), and including any training/qualifications. We encourage you to include examples of where you have demonstrated the requirements/criteria in the advert / job profile to allow the panel to fully recognise your skills and abilities. You will have the opportunity to include a short covering paragraph within your application to give us a little more information about your skills, knowledge, and experiences.

Additional information

We are changing
Hertfordshire County Councilis undergoing Local Government Reorganisation (LGR). If you are employed by Hertfordshire County on 1 April 2028, it is expected that most roles will transfer to the newly-created unitary councils on existing terms and conditions under TUPE (Transfer of Undertakings - Protection of Employment) principles.

LGR is one of the biggest changes we will face in a generation. It will reshape how we work and how services are organised and gives us a real opportunity to build something better. To find out more, visit

DisabilityConfident
We are proud to be a and guarantee an interview to anyone disclosing a disability whose application meets the minimum criteria for the post.

English Fluency
The ability to converse at ease with members of the public and provide advice in accurate spoken English is essential for the post (for those whose language is a signed language the provision of a sign language interpreter who speaks English to the necessary standard of fluency will be required).

title: Digital Marketing Executive
company: The Institution of Engineering & Technology - Agency - Permanent
description:
- Are you passionate about developing and delivering digital marketing campaigns that drive engagement, align with strategic objectives, and achieve measurable impact?
- Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment, managing multi-channel campaigns, optimising digital strategies, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure success?
- Could you be our next Digital Marketing Executive, helping to deliver high-impact campaigns that drive attendance, registrations and engagement across the IET's events, learning and awards portfolios?

At the IET, making our world a better place starts by creating a better place for our people. At the IET you'll have more than just a job. Our work is exciting and challenging, connecting the people who solve the problems that matter. It means working with us has real meaning and impact, and you'll grow - professionally and personally - in ways you never thought possible. We're also making significant investments in our people, including providing a modern, vibrant workplace and embracing hybrid working.

What you'll be doing

As a Digital Marketing Executive, you will play a key role in delivering and optimising our digital marketing campaigns across multiple platforms. With a focus on email marketing, social media, digital advertising, content marketing, and web updates, you'll ensure our digital efforts are aligned with overall campaign objectives and best practices. This role will primarily support the IET's campaigns for events, courses and awards, and you will be joining a team of 20+ marketing campaign professionals.

You'll work closely with our Marketing Campaign Managers and Digital Marketing Specialists to execute impactful digital marketing tactics, monitor performance, and drive engagement. Your ability to analyse data and identify opportunities for optimisation will play a key part in improving campaign effectiveness and return on investment.

If you thrive in a dynamic environment, enjoy variety in your work, and love collaborating with stakeholders to deliver results, this role offers an exciting opportunity to develop and expand your digital marketing expertise.

What we hope you can bring to the role

We're looking for someone with hands-on experience in digital marketing, particularly across email marketing, organic and paid social media, PPC, and web content management. You'll bring a data-driven approach, strong organisational skills, and a keen eye for detail, ensuring digital marketing activities are effective, compliant, and optimised for best performance.

The ideal candidate will have experience using digital marketing tools, be confident in managing multiple projects, and have a passion for staying ahead of digital trends. Your ability to communicate effectively, analyse campaign performance, and collaborate with stakeholders will be essential.

A little more about the role
- Plan, build, and execute targeted email marketing campaigns, ensuring they are well-designed, engaging, and optimised for use (mobile, for example).
- Manage and schedule organic social media posts, ensuring alignment with platform best practices and analysing performance for optimisation.
- Assist in setting up and managing pay-per-click (PPC) campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads and social media.
- Regularly update and maintain website content using the Umbraco CMS, ensuring accuracy, SEO-friendliness, and a seamless user experience.
- Create, capture, edit and repurpose engaging campaign content for use across channels, including photography and video
- Monitor and analyse digital marketing performance across email, social media, PPC, and web, providing insights and recommendations to enhance engagement and ROI.
- Work closely with Marketing Campaign Managers to ensure cohesive messaging and integrated digital campaigns.
- Assist in conducting A/B tests for digital ads, emails, and landing pages to improve campaign effectiveness.
- Support budget management for digital campaigns, ensuring activities are cost-effective and deliver strong results.
- Stay up-to-date with data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR) and digital marketing best practices to ensure compliance and excellence in execution.

A little more about what we're looking for
- Proven experience in digital marketing, including email marketing, social media management, PPC, and web content management.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and make data-driven decisions to optimise performance.
- Experience using email marketing platforms (e.g., Upland Adestra, Mailchimp), PPC/social ads management tools (e.g., Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads), social media management tools (e.g., Sprinklr, Hootsuite), and CMS platforms (e.g., Umbraco, WordPress).
- Experience creating or editing marketing content, including social media assets, photography and/or video content, with an understanding of how content should be adapted for different channels and audiences.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with confidence in engaging with internal stakeholders and external audiences.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines efficiently.
- Proactive and eager to learn, with a passion for digital marketing and staying ahead of industry trends.
- A collaborative mindset, with experience working in cross-functional teams to achieve marketing goals.

If you're passionate about digital marketing and content creation, and are keen to develop your skills across digital marketing channels, this role offers a fantastic opportunity to gain hands-on experience, supporting the successful deliver of the IET's Events, Learning and Courses campaigns.

This is a hybrid role based in Stevenage, with the team coming into the office twice per week. Our marketing team anchor day is Thursday. Occasional UK travel will also be required to support content capture at events, courses and other IET activities.

title: Marketing Campaign Manager
company: The Institution of Engineering & Technology - Agency - Permanent
description:
- Are you passionate about creating B2 B marketing campaigns guided by cutting-edge marketing and digital best practices, that drive engagement and deliver business impact?
- Do you thrive on working closely with sales teams to develop campaigns, content and sales enablement activity that supports account growth?
- Could you take ownership of end-to-end campaign management and deliver marketing activity that connects customer challenges with a broad portfolio of products, services and solutions?

At the IET, you'll do more than just a job. You'll help connect the people solving the problems that matter, making a meaningful contribution while developing professionally and personally. We're investing in our people through a modern workplace, hybrid working and a culture that supports growth.

If you're a commercially minded B2 B marketer driven by curiosity and continuous learning, you'll join a supportive marketing and communications community of 40+ professionals, with plenty of opportunities to learn, collaborate and develop your career.

Hybrid Working Arrangement

We support flexible working, with an expectation of being in our Stevenage office two days per week. Thursdays are our key team day, when everyone comes together to support collaboration and connection across the marketing team.

What you'll be doing

As one of our Marketing Campaign Managers, you'll lead B2 B and sales enablement campaigns that support the IET's growth ambitions. You'll deliver integrated, insight-led campaigns that engage businesses, industry partners and professional audiences, taking activity from planning through to execution, optimisation and performance measurement.

Our B2 B approach focuses on helping organisations address challenges around workforce capability, professional standards and business growth, rather than promoting products alone. You'll play a key role in bringing this strategy to life.

Working closely with Sales, Product and Portfolio Management teams, you'll deliver sector-focused campaigns, thought leadership and sales enablement activity that drive meaningful customer engagement and commercial growth.

You'll collaborate with Marketing Campaign Executives, Digital Marketing Executives, specialist marketing teams and external agencies to develop compelling content and campaign assets aligned to business objectives. Using data and insight, you'll optimise performance, demonstrate ROI and manage budgets effectively to maximise impact.

You'll help organisations understand how the IET can support their goals while equipping Sales teams with the content, tools and assets they need to maximise opportunities. As business priorities evolve, you'll also have the opportunity to support campaigns across other areas of the organisation.

What we hope you can bring to the role

We're looking for an experienced marketer with a strong track record of delivering end-to-end B2 B campaigns. You'll be able to turn strategy into measurable activity, managing campaigns from planning through to delivery, optimisation and evaluation.

Organised and commercially minded, you'll manage multiple priorities while using insight and data to improve performance, demonstrate impact and maximise budget effectiveness. You'll work closely with colleagues across marketing, sales and delivery, as well as agency partners, providing clear briefs and direction to ensure successful campaign execution.

You'll also be supported to continue developing your skills through access to learning platforms such as Target Internet and Propolis, helping you stay current with marketing best practice and emerging trends.

A little more about the role
- Develop and deliver insight-led B2 B marketing campaigns aligned to business objectives and commercial growth.
- Create sales enablement, customer engagement and thought leadership activity that supports customer conversations, account growth and engagement.
- Deliver sector-focused marketing that positions the IET as a trusted partner for workforce capability, professional standards and business growth.
- Manage campaigns end-to-end, from planning and briefing through to delivery and evaluation.
- Collaborate with Brand, Creative and Digital teams to produce effective content and campaign assets across multiple channels.
- Coordinate activity across digital, email, partnerships, events and offline channels as required.
- Monitor, analyse and report on campaign performance, using insight to optimise activity and demonstrate ROI.
- Work closely with Sales, Impact and Member & Customer Engagement teams to support lead generation, conversion and customer engagement.
- Manage campaign budgets effectively to maximise value and impact.
- Apply audience segmentation and personalisation to improve campaign relevance and performance.
- Keep up to date with marketing trends and best practice, applying learning to enhance campaign effectiveness.

A little more about what we're looking for
- Proven experience delivering successful B2 B marketing campaigns that support commercial objectives.
- Experience working with Sales teams to create sales enablement activity, customer communications and engagement programmes.
- Ability to translate customer needs and business challenges into compelling campaigns, content and marketing initiatives.
- Strong knowledge of digital marketing channels, including email, PPC, search and social media.
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to use data and insight to improve performance and demonstrate impact.
- Excellent planning and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
- Experience briefing and working with creative teams and external partners to deliver high-quality, on-brand assets.
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence, collaborate and delegate effectively.
- Experience managing budgets and maximising return on investment.
- A proactive and adaptable approach, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: Marketing Coordinator
description:
Social Media & Marketing Coordinator (Entry Level)
Location: Welwyn Garden City, Hertfordshire
Salary: Up to £30,000 + Benefits

Grown your own social media following? Know your way around software like Canva, CapCut and AI tools? Want to turn that into a proper marketing career? This entry-level Social Media & Marketing Coordinator role is a great place to start.

About the company
A respected private housebuilder delivering high-quality new homes across Hertfordshire and the surrounding area, based at their head office in Welwyn Garden City. It's a close, friendly team where you'll work directly with the people running the business.

The role
This is a brand new role. The business is bringing its social media and marketing in-house for the first time, and wants someone keen and creative to take it on and grow with it. As Social Media & Marketing Coordinator you'll report to the Sales & Marketing Director, who will support you as you learn the property side.
You don't need years of marketing experience. You do need to know what makes people stop scrolling, and to be keen to learn the rest.

Key responsibilities:
- Creating and posting content across Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn
- Getting out to developments and show homes to take photos and short videos
- Designing graphics and writing captions, using tools like Canva, CapCut and AI where they help
- Updating the website with new developments and news
- Helping produce email newsletters, brochures and sales materials
- Supporting show home launches and sales events
- Planning a regular content calendar and keeping track of what gets the most engagement and enquiries

What they're looking for:
- Someone who's built and run their own social media, for themselves, a side project, a club or a small business, and can show it
- Confident on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and LinkedIn, and up to date with what works on each
- Quick to pick up new software. Experience with Canva, CapCut, Adobe or similar is a bonus
- Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT or Claude to speed up ideas, captions and planning, while keeping it sounding human
- Creative, organised and happy to get out and about with a phone or camera
- Interest in property or housebuilding is a plus, but not essential, and a marketing or media qualification is nice to have
- A full UK driving licence, as you'll be out on site regularly

What's on offer:
- Salary up to £30,000 depending on experience
- 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays
- Private healthcare with BUPA after probation
- A brand new role you can make your own, with real responsibility from day one
- Support from the Sales & Marketing Director, and a clear chance to build a career in marketing
- Monday to Friday, 8.30am-5pm, office based in Welwyn Garden City, with regular site visits

If you're a creative, social-savvy person who wants to turn what you already do online into a Social Media & Marketing Coordinator career, this is a great first step.

To apply, send your CV along with links to the social accounts or content you're proudest of.

title: Marketing Executive - Professional Services
description:
As a Marketing Executive - Professional Services, you will manage day-to-day marketing activity for a growing firm, helping to keep campaigns and communications organised. You will work closely with the wider team to deliver clear, consistent marketing that supports the wider business.

Client Details

The organisation operates in the Professional Services industry and has offices in between Watford and St. Albans.

Please note - this is an office based role

Description

As the Marketing Executive - Professional Services, you will have the following responsibilities:
- Support the delivery of multi-channel marketing campaigns across digital, content, email, social media and events.
- Coordinate and attend industry events, exhibitions and networking opportunities, helping to generate leads and raise brand awareness.
- Identify and engage prospective clients through targeted business development and marketing activity.
- Create and manage marketing content including email campaigns, social media posts, website updates and promotional materials.
- Track campaign performance, analyse results and provide insights to optimise future activity.
- Maintain CRM and marketing databases, ensuring accurate reporting of leads, opportunities and campaign effectiveness.
- Work closely with sales and commercial teams to support lead generation, pipeline growth and customer engagement.
- Monitor market trends, competitor activity and customer insights to identify new opportunities for growth.

Profile

A successful Marketing Executive - Professional Services should have:
- Experience delivering day-to-day marketing activity, ideally gained from within a professional services environment
- Experience coordinating marketing campaigns from planning through to delivery.
- Experience planning, coordinating and supporting events, exhibitions and networking activities, with a proven ability to maximise engagement and generate new business opportunities.
- Ability to create clear marketing content and communications.
- Confidence managing multiple marketing tasks and deadlines.
- Strong attention to detail when reviewing marketing materials and information.
- Ability to keep campaign plans, documents and actions well organised.

Job Offer
- Salary of 35,000 to 45,000 dependent on the level of experience.
- Please note that this role will be office based (office is based between Watford and St. Albans).

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

People are at the heart of Michael Page. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment. As an inclusive recruiter we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and experiences. If you require any adjustments or accommodations during the recruitment process, we'll work with you to ensure you can perform at your best.

title: Senior Communications and PR Executive
company: The Institution of Engineering & Technology - Agency - Permanent
description:
- Are you passionate about uncovering and sharing powerful engineering and technology stories, with the communications skills to bring them to life?
- Do you enjoy building relationships with journalists, spotting media opportunities and creating content that makes an impact?
- Could you be our next Senior Communications and PR Executive, helping to strengthen the reputation and visibility of one of the world's leading engineering institutions on a mission to engineer a better world?

If you're a communications or PR professional driven by curiosity, storytelling and meaningful impact, this could be the place where you grow too. You'll be joining a large, supportive marketing and communications community - a team of 40+ professionals, giving you the chance to learn from experienced peers, share your own expertise, and grow through collaboration.

Hybrid working arrangement - As part of our hybrid approach, you'll need to be in the office 2 times a week, with Thursday as an essential requirement to support collaboration and connection across the Communications and Marketing team.

What you'll be doing

As a Senior Communications and PR Executive, you'll be a highly visible member of our dynamic and fast-paced Corporate Communications team, playing a pivotal role in protecting and enhancing the reputation of the IET, one of the world's largest professional engineering and technology organisations. Working across media relations, public relations, content creation and colleague communications, you'll help raise the profile of the IET and bring our purpose to life for members, volunteers, journalists, colleagues and wider society.

As a well-rounded communications professional, you'll be a natural collaborator with creative flair who can bridge our external and internal communications work. You'll uncover and develop compelling engineering and technology stories, build relationships with journalists and media contacts, support thought leadership opportunities, and create engaging content that helps position the IET as a trusted voice on the issues that matter most to our audiences.

You'll also play an important role in delivering communications campaigns, supporting senior leaders with impactful communications, and helping colleagues stay informed, engaged and connected to our mission to engineer a better world. Whether you're pitching a story to the media, writing content for Member News, supporting a corporate campaign or creating communications for colleagues, you'll be at the heart of how we engage and inspire our audiences.

What we hope you can bring to the role

We're looking for a talented communications professional with experience in PR, journalism, corporate communications or a related field, and a proven ability to create engaging content that builds reputation and connects with audiences.

You'll be a confident communicator and relationship builder, able to work with journalists, colleagues, volunteers, subject matter experts and senior stakeholders to uncover stories and bring them to life across multiple channels. Comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment, you'll have a strong eye for communications opportunities.

If you're passionate about storytelling, have excellent writing and editing skills, and enjoy turning complex engineering and technology topics into engaging content, we'd love to hear from you.

Experience in media relations, digital content creation or communications campaigns is essential, alongside an understanding of how effective colleague communications support organisational performance, engagement and reputation.

A little more about the role
- Develop, write and pitch engaging engineering and technology stories that help raise the profile of the IET and position us as a leading voice.
- Build relationships with journalists, manage media enquiries and support the delivery of PR activity including media briefings, press events and influencer engagement.
- Design and deliver impactful communications campaigns that support the IET's strategy, programmes and organisational priorities.
- Research, write and create compelling content across traditional and digital channels, including news stories, blogs, social media, thought leadership content and Member News, our flagship publication for members.
- Monitor engineering and technology developments, identifying opportunities for the IET to contribute to emerging conversations and raise its visibility.
- Write speeches, presentations and briefing materials for senior representatives, including the Chief Executive and IET President.
- Brief and support colleagues, volunteers and senior leaders ahead of media interviews, speaking engagements and key communications activity.
- Support colleague engagement through effective use of organisational communications channels and platforms, including the intranet.
- Track communications performance and use insight to continually improve the effectiveness and impact of our work.

A little more about what we're looking for
- Experience in communications, PR, journalism or a related discipline, with a track record of delivering high-quality content and campaigns.
- Strong writing, editing and proofreading skills, with the ability to tailor content for different audiences and channels.
- Experience developing media stories, working with journalists or supporting PR activity.
- Excellent stakeholder management skills, including the ability to work confidently with senior leaders and subject matter experts.
- Knowledge of social media platforms and digital communications channels.
- Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to balance multiple priorities and deadlines.
- A proactive and curious approach, with a keen eye for identifying stories and communications opportunities.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to measure performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
- A collaborative mindset and willingness to contribute positively to a supportive team environment.
